When to use: creating a new file, or fully replacing one you've already Read. Overwriting an existing file you haven't Read will fail. For partial changes, use Edit instead.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write (must be absolute, not relative)

content.description: The content to write to the file

1	REPORT ysc4sap_auth_u1.
2	
3	* YSC4SAP_AUTH_U1 - read only. Checks the catalog authorizations of the biz actions
4	* for another user (AUTHORITY_CHECK with USER) and for the caller. No data change.
5	
6	CLASS ltcl_auth DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING DURATION SHORT RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.
7	  PRIVATE SECTION.
8	    CONSTANTS c_user TYPE xubname VALUE '29OT5100B5'.
9	    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chk,
10	             act  TYPE string,
11	             obj  TYPE xuobject,
12	             spec TYPE string,
13	           END OF ty_chk.
14	    DATA mt_chk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chk WITH EMPTY KEY.
15	    DATA mt_var TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
16	    METHODS run FOR TESTING.
17	    METHODS out IMPORTING iv TYPE csequence.
18	    METHODS chk IMPORTING iv_act TYPE string iv_obj TYPE xuobject iv_spec TYPE string.
19	    METHODS subst IMPORTING iv TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
20	    METHODS check_one IMPORTING iv_user TYPE xubname is_chk TYPE ty_chk
21	                      RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
22	ENDCLASS.
23	
24	CLASS ltcl_auth IMPLEMENTATION.
25	
26	  METHOD out.
27	    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = iv quit = if_aunit_constants=>no level = if_aunit_constants=>tolerable ).
28	  ENDMETHOD.
29	
30	  METHOD chk.
31	    APPEND VALUE #( act = iv_act obj = iv_obj spec = iv_spec ) TO mt_chk.
32	  ENDMETHOD.
33	
34	  METHOD subst.
35	    rv = iv.
36	    LOOP AT mt_var INTO DATA(lv_var).
37	      SPLIT lv_var AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_k) DATA(lv_v).
38	      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_k IN rv WITH lv_v.
39	    ENDLOOP.
40	  ENDMETHOD.
41	
42	  METHOD check_one.
43	    DATA: lt_f TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xufield WITH EMPTY KEY,
44	          lt_v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xuval WITH EMPTY KEY,
45	          lv_f TYPE xufield, lv_v TYPE xuval.
46	    DATA(lv_spec) = subst( is_chk-spec ).
47	    SPLIT lv_spec AT ';' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_pairs).
48	    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
49	      SPLIT lv_pair AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_fn) DATA(lv_fv).
50	      lv_f = lv_fn. lv_v = lv_fv.
51	      " field must belong to the object
52	      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tobj WHERE objct = is_chk-obj
53	        AND ( fiel1 = lv_f OR fiel2 = lv_f OR fiel3 = lv_f OR fiel4 = lv_f OR fiel5 = lv_f
54	           OR fiel6 = lv_f OR fiel7 = lv_f OR fiel8 = lv_f OR fiel9 = lv_f OR fiel0 = lv_f ).
55	      IF sy-dbcnt = 0.
56	        rv = |BADFIELD { lv_f }|.
57	        RETURN.
58	      ENDIF.
59	      APPEND lv_f TO lt_f. APPEND lv_v TO lt_v.
60	    ENDLOOP.
61	    DO 10 - lines( lt_f ) TIMES.
62	      APPEND space TO lt_f. APPEND space TO lt_v.
63	    ENDDO.
64	    CALL FUNCTION 'AUTHORITY_CHECK'
65	      EXPORTING
66	        user    = iv_user
67	        object  = is_chk-obj
68	        field1  = lt_f[ 1 ]  value1  = lt_v[ 1 ]
69	        field2  = lt_f[ 2 ]  value2  = lt_v[ 2 ]
70	        field3  = lt_f[ 3 ]  value3  = lt_v[ 3 ]
71	        field4  = lt_f[ 4 ]  value4  = lt_v[ 4 ]
72	        field5  = lt_f[ 5 ]  value5  = lt_v[ 5 ]
73	        field6  = lt_f[ 6 ]  value6  = lt_v[ 6 ]
74	        field7  = lt_f[ 7 ]  value7  = lt_v[ 7 ]
75	        field8  = lt_f[ 8 ]  value8  = lt_v[ 8 ]
76	        field9  = lt_f[ 9 ]  value9  = lt_v[ 9 ]
77	        field10 = lt_f[ 10 ] value10 = lt_v[ 10 ]
78	      EXCEPTIONS
79	        user_dont_exist     = 1
80	        user_is_authorized  = 2
81	        user_not_authorized = 3
82	        user_is_locked      = 4
83	        OTHERS              = 5.
84	    rv = SWITCH #( sy-subrc WHEN 2 THEN 'OK' WHEN 3 THEN 'DENY' WHEN 1 THEN 'NOUSER'
85	                            WHEN 4 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE |RC{ sy-subrc }| ).
86	  ENDMETHOD.
87	
88	  METHOD run.
89	    " ---- user facts (no address, no password data)
90	    CALL FUNCTION 'SUSR_USER_CHECK_EXISTENCE'
91	      EXPORTING user_name = c_user
92	      EXCEPTIONS user_name_not_exists = 1 OTHERS = 2.
93	    out( |AU#USER#{ c_user }#exists={ COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN 'X' ELSE '-' ) }#caller={ sy-uname }#client={ sy-mandt }| ).

REPORT ysc4sap_auth_u1.

* YSC4SAP_AUTH_U1 - read only. Checks the catalog authorizations of the biz actions
* for another user (AUTHORITY_CHECK with USER) and for the caller. No data change.

CLASS ltcl_auth DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING DURATION SHORT RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS c_user TYPE xubname VALUE '29OT5100B5'.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chk,
             act  TYPE string,
             obj  TYPE xuobject,
             spec TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chk.
    DATA mt_chk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chk WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_var TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS run FOR TESTING.
    METHODS out IMPORTING iv TYPE csequence.
    METHODS chk IMPORTING iv_act TYPE string iv_obj TYPE xuobject iv_spec TYPE string.
    METHODS subst IMPORTING iv TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
    METHODS check_one IMPORTING iv_user TYPE xubname is_chk TYPE ty_chk
                      RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_auth IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD out.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = iv quit = if_aunit_constants=>no level = if_aunit_constants=>tolerable ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk.
    APPEND VALUE #( act = iv_act obj = iv_obj spec = iv_spec ) TO mt_chk.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subst.
    rv = iv.
    LOOP AT mt_var INTO DATA(lv_var).
      SPLIT lv_var AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_k) DATA(lv_v).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_k IN rv WITH lv_v.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_one.
    DATA: lt_f TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xufield WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xuval WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_f TYPE xufield, lv_v TYPE xuval.
    DATA(lv_spec) = subst( is_chk-spec ).
    SPLIT lv_spec AT ';' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_pairs).
    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
      SPLIT lv_pair AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_fn) DATA(lv_fv).
      lv_f = lv_fn. lv_v = lv_fv.
      " field must belong to the object
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tobj WHERE objct = is_chk-obj
        AND ( fiel1 = lv_f OR fiel2 = lv_f OR fiel3 = lv_f OR fiel4 = lv_f OR fiel5 = lv_f
           OR fiel6 = lv_f OR fiel7 = lv_f OR fiel8 = lv_f OR fiel9 = lv_f OR fiel0 = lv_f ).
      IF sy-dbcnt = 0.
        rv = |BADFIELD { lv_f }|.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_f TO lt_f. APPEND lv_v TO lt_v.
    ENDLOOP.
    DO 10 - lines( lt_f ) TIMES.
      APPEND space TO lt_f. APPEND space TO lt_v.
    ENDDO.
    CALL FUNCTION 'AUTHORITY_CHECK'
      EXPORTING
        user    = iv_user
        object  = is_chk-obj
        field1  = lt_f[ 1 ]  value1  = lt_v[ 1 ]
        field2  = lt_f[ 2 ]  value2  = lt_v[ 2 ]
        field3  = lt_f[ 3 ]  value3  = lt_v[ 3 ]
        field4  = lt_f[ 4 ]  value4  = lt_v[ 4 ]
        field5  = lt_f[ 5 ]  value5  = lt_v[ 5 ]
        field6  = lt_f[ 6 ]  value6  = lt_v[ 6 ]
        field7  = lt_f[ 7 ]  value7  = lt_v[ 7 ]
        field8  = lt_f[ 8 ]  value8  = lt_v[ 8 ]
        field9  = lt_f[ 9 ]  value9  = lt_v[ 9 ]
        field10 = lt_f[ 10 ] value10 = lt_v[ 10 ]
      EXCEPTIONS
        user_dont_exist     = 1
        user_is_authorized  = 2
        user_not_authorized = 3
        user_is_locked      = 4
        OTHERS              = 5.
    rv = SWITCH #( sy-subrc WHEN 2 THEN 'OK' WHEN 3 THEN 'DENY' WHEN 1 THEN 'NOUSER'
                            WHEN 4 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE |RC{ sy-subrc }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run.
    " ---- user facts (no address, no password data)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SUSR_USER_CHECK_EXISTENCE'
      EXPORTING user_name = c_user
      EXCEPTIONS user_name_not_exists = 1 OTHERS = 2.
    out( |AU#USER#{ c_user }#exists={ COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN 'X' ELSE '-' ) }#caller={ sy-uname }#client={ sy-mandt }| ).
    SELECT SINGLE ustyp, uflag, gltgv, gltgb FROM usr02 WHERE bname = @c_user INTO @DATA(ls_u).
    out( |AU#LOGON#type={ ls_u-ustyp }#lockflag={ ls_u-uflag }#valid={ ls_u-gltgv }-{ ls_u-gltgb }| ).
    SELECT agr_name FROM agr_users WHERE uname = @c_user AND from_dat <= @sy-datum AND to_dat >= @sy-datum
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_roles).
    DATA(lv_roles) = ``.
    LOOP AT lt_roles INTO DATA(ls_r). lv_roles = |{ lv_roles }{ ls_r-agr_name },|. ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#ROLES#{ lines( lt_roles ) }#{ lv_roles }| ).

    " ---- org values from the test documents
    SELECT SINGLE ekgrp, frggr, frgsx, bsart FROM ekko WHERE ebeln = '8000000007' INTO @DATA(ls_po).
    SELECT SINGLE werks FROM ekpo WHERE ebeln = '8000000007' INTO @DATA(lv_po_werks).
    SELECT SINGLE frgc1 FROM t16fs WHERE frggr = @ls_po-frggr AND frgsx = @ls_po-frgsx INTO @DATA(lv_frgco).
    SELECT SINGLE vkorg, vtweg, spart, auart FROM vbak WHERE vbeln = '3100003658' INTO @DATA(ls_so).
    SELECT SINGLE vstel, fkarv FROM likp WHERE vbeln = '8100002214' INTO @DATA(ls_dl).
    SELECT SINGLE brgru FROM t003 WHERE blart = 'SA' INTO @DATA(lv_brgru).
    SELECT SINGLE auart, kokrs FROM aufk WHERE aufnr = '000800001501' INTO @DATA(ls_co).
    SELECT SINGLE kostl FROM csks WHERE kokrs = @ls_co-kokrs AND datbi >= @sy-datum INTO @DATA(lv_kostl).
    SELECT SINGLE werks, auart FROM aufk WHERE autyp = '10' INTO @DATA(ls_pp).
    mt_var = VALUE #(
      ( |<EKGRP>={ ls_po-ekgrp }| ) ( |<FRGGR>={ ls_po-frggr }| ) ( |<FRGCO>={ lv_frgco }| ) ( |<POWERKS>={ lv_po_werks }| )
      ( |<VKORG>={ ls_so-vkorg }| ) ( |<VTWEG>={ ls_so-vtweg }| ) ( |<SPART>={ ls_so-spart }| ) ( |<AUART>={ ls_so-auart }| )
      ( |<VSTEL>={ ls_dl-vstel }| ) ( |<FKART>={ ls_dl-fkarv }| ) ( |<BUKRS>=1100| ) ( |<BRGRU>={ lv_brgru }| )
      ( |<COAUART>={ ls_co-auart }| ) ( |<KOKRS>={ ls_co-kokrs }| ) ( |<KOSTL>={ lv_kostl }| )
      ( |<PPWERKS>={ ls_pp-werks }| ) ( |<PPAUART>={ ls_pp-auart }| ) ).
    DATA(lv_vars) = ``.
    LOOP AT mt_var INTO DATA(lv_x). lv_vars = |{ lv_vars }{ lv_x } |. ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#VARS#{ lv_vars }| ).

    " ---- catalog authorizations (configs/*/actions.json auth[])
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.LIST_OPEN` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKG' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;EKGRP=<EKGRP>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.DELETE_ITEM` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=06` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.RELEASE` iv_obj = 'M_EINK_FRG' iv_spec = `FRGGR=<FRGGR>;FRGCO=<FRGCO>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.GR.POST` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWE' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=101` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.GR.POST` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_WWE' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;WERKS=<POWERKS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.*` iv_obj = 'C_AFKO_AWK' iv_spec = `WERKS=<PPWERKS>;AUFART=<PPAUART>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.CONFIRM` iv_obj = 'C_AFRU_AWK' iv_spec = `WERKS=<PPWERKS>;AUFART=<PPAUART>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.GOODS_ISSUE` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=261` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;VTWEG=<VTWEG>;SPART=<SPART>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_AAT' iv_spec = `AUART=<AUART>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;VTWEG=<VTWEG>;SPART=<SPART>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_AAT' iv_spec = `AUART=<AUART>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.LIST_OPEN` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.POST_GI` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.POST_GI` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=601` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.BIL.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_VBRK_FKA' iv_spec = `FKART=<FKART>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.BIL.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_VBRK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.DOC.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BLA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BRGRU=<BRGRU>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_KOA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;KOART=S` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.ITEM.*` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.ORD.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'K_ORDER' iv_spec = `AUFART=<COAUART>;CO_ACTION=0003` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.ORD.SET_STATUS` iv_obj = 'K_ORDER' iv_spec = `AUFART=<COAUART>;CO_ACTION=0011` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.CC.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.REPOST.COSTS` iv_obj = 'K_CCA' iv_spec = `CO_ACTION=2076` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.REPOST.COSTS` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.PLAN.PRIMARY` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS_PLA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).

    " ---- controls: HR object (role name says non-HR) and an unknown user
    DATA(ls_ctl) = VALUE ty_chk( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'P_ORGIN' spec = `INFTY=0008;AUTHC=R` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#P_ORGIN#user={ check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_ctl ) }#caller={ check_one( iv_user = sy-uname is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    ls_ctl = VALUE #( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' spec = `ACTVT=03` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#NOUSER#{ check_one( iv_user = 'ZZNOUSER999' is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    ls_ctl = VALUE #( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'S_USER_GRP' spec = `ACTVT=01;CLASS=SUPER` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#S_USER_GRP#user={ check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    DATA(lv_deny) = 0.
    LOOP AT mt_chk INTO DATA(ls_c).

    ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#SUM#checks={ lines( mt_chk ) }#user_not_ok={ lv_deny }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

REPORT ysc4sap_auth_u1.

* YSC4SAP_AUTH_U1 - read only. Checks the catalog authorizations of the biz actions
* for another user (AUTHORITY_CHECK with USER) and for the caller. No data change.

CLASS ltcl_auth DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING DURATION SHORT RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS c_user TYPE xubname VALUE '11A01101B12'.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chk,
             act  TYPE string,
             obj  TYPE xuobject,
             spec TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chk.
    DATA mt_chk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chk WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_var TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS run FOR TESTING.
    METHODS out IMPORTING iv TYPE csequence.
    METHODS chk IMPORTING iv_act TYPE string iv_obj TYPE xuobject iv_spec TYPE string.
    METHODS subst IMPORTING iv TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
    METHODS check_one IMPORTING iv_user TYPE xubname is_chk TYPE ty_chk
                      RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_auth IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD out.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = iv quit = if_aunit_constants=>no level = if_aunit_constants=>tolerable ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk.
    APPEND VALUE #( act = iv_act obj = iv_obj spec = iv_spec ) TO mt_chk.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subst.
    rv = iv.
    LOOP AT mt_var INTO DATA(lv_var).
      SPLIT lv_var AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_k) DATA(lv_v).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_k IN rv WITH lv_v.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_one.
    DATA: lt_f TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xufield WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xuval WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_f TYPE xufield, lv_v TYPE xuval.
    DATA(lv_spec) = subst( is_chk-spec ).
    SPLIT lv_spec AT ';' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_pairs).
    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
      SPLIT lv_pair AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_fn) DATA(lv_fv).
      lv_f = lv_fn. lv_v = lv_fv.
      " field must belong to the object
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tobj WHERE objct = is_chk-obj
        AND ( fiel1 = lv_f OR fiel2 = lv_f OR fiel3 = lv_f OR fiel4 = lv_f OR fiel5 = lv_f
           OR fiel6 = lv_f OR fiel7 = lv_f OR fiel8 = lv_f OR fiel9 = lv_f OR fiel0 = lv_f ).
      IF sy-dbcnt = 0.
        rv = |BADFIELD { lv_f }|.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_f TO lt_f. APPEND lv_v TO lt_v.
    ENDLOOP.
    DO 10 - lines( lt_f ) TIMES.
      APPEND space TO lt_f. APPEND space TO lt_v.
    ENDDO.
    CALL FUNCTION 'AUTHORITY_CHECK'
      EXPORTING
        user    = iv_user
        object  = is_chk-obj
        field1  = lt_f[ 1 ]  value1  = lt_v[ 1 ]
        field2  = lt_f[ 2 ]  value2  = lt_v[ 2 ]
        field3  = lt_f[ 3 ]  value3  = lt_v[ 3 ]
        field4  = lt_f[ 4 ]  value4  = lt_v[ 4 ]
        field5  = lt_f[ 5 ]  value5  = lt_v[ 5 ]
        field6  = lt_f[ 6 ]  value6  = lt_v[ 6 ]
        field7  = lt_f[ 7 ]  value7  = lt_v[ 7 ]
        field8  = lt_f[ 8 ]  value8  = lt_v[ 8 ]
        field9  = lt_f[ 9 ]  value9  = lt_v[ 9 ]
        field10 = lt_f[ 10 ] value10 = lt_v[ 10 ]
      EXCEPTIONS
        user_dont_exist     = 1
        user_is_authorized  = 2
        user_not_authorized = 3
        user_is_locked      = 4
        OTHERS              = 5.
    rv = SWITCH #( sy-subrc WHEN 2 THEN 'OK' WHEN 3 THEN 'DENY' WHEN 1 THEN 'NOUSER'
                            WHEN 4 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE |RC{ sy-subrc }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run.
    " ---- user facts (no address, no password data)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SUSR_USER_CHECK_EXISTENCE'
      EXPORTING user_name = c_user
      EXCEPTIONS user_name_not_exists = 1 OTHERS = 2.
    out( |AU#USER#{ c_user }#exists={ COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN 'X' ELSE '-' ) }#caller={ sy-uname }#client={ sy-mandt }| ).
    SELECT SINGLE ustyp, uflag, gltgv, gltgb FROM usr02 WHERE bname = @c_user INTO @DATA(ls_u).
    out( |AU#LOGON#type={ ls_u-ustyp }#lockflag={ ls_u-uflag }#valid={ ls_u-gltgv }-{ ls_u-gltgb }| ).
    SELECT agr_name FROM agr_users WHERE uname = @c_user AND from_dat <= @sy-datum AND to_dat >= @sy-datum
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_roles).
    DATA(lv_roles) = ``.
    LOOP AT lt_roles INTO DATA(ls_r). lv_roles = |{ lv_roles }{ ls_r-agr_name },|. ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#ROLES#{ lines( lt_roles ) }#{ lv_roles }| ).

    " ---- org values from the test documents
    SELECT SINGLE ekgrp, frggr, frgsx, bsart FROM ekko WHERE ebeln = '8000000007' INTO @DATA(ls_po).
    SELECT SINGLE werks FROM ekpo WHERE ebeln = '8000000007' INTO @DATA(lv_po_werks).
    SELECT SINGLE frgc1 FROM t16fs WHERE frggr = @ls_po-frggr AND frgsx = @ls_po-frgsx INTO @DATA(lv_frgco).
    SELECT SINGLE vkorg, vtweg, spart, auart FROM vbak WHERE vbeln = '3100003658' INTO @DATA(ls_so).
    SELECT SINGLE vstel, fkarv FROM likp WHERE vbeln = '8100002214' INTO @DATA(ls_dl).
    SELECT SINGLE brgru FROM t003 WHERE blart = 'SA' INTO @DATA(lv_brgru).
    SELECT SINGLE auart, kokrs FROM aufk WHERE aufnr = '000800001501' INTO @DATA(ls_co).
    SELECT SINGLE kostl FROM csks WHERE kokrs = @ls_co-kokrs AND datbi >= @sy-datum INTO @DATA(lv_kostl).
    SELECT SINGLE werks, auart FROM aufk WHERE autyp = '10' INTO @DATA(ls_pp).
    mt_var = VALUE #(
      ( |<EKGRP>={ ls_po-ekgrp }| ) ( |<FRGGR>={ ls_po-frggr }| ) ( |<FRGCO>={ lv_frgco }| ) ( |<POWERKS>={ lv_po_werks }| )
      ( |<VKORG>={ ls_so-vkorg }| ) ( |<VTWEG>={ ls_so-vtweg }| ) ( |<SPART>={ ls_so-spart }| ) ( |<AUART>={ ls_so-auart }| )
      ( |<VSTEL>={ ls_dl-vstel }| ) ( |<FKART>={ ls_dl-fkarv }| ) ( |<BUKRS>=1100| ) ( |<BRGRU>={ lv_brgru }| )
      ( |<COAUART>={ ls_co-auart }| ) ( |<KOKRS>={ ls_co-kokrs }| ) ( |<KOSTL>={ lv_kostl }| )
      ( |<PPWERKS>={ ls_pp-werks }| ) ( |<PPAUART>={ ls_pp-auart }| ) ).
    DATA(lv_vars) = ``.
    LOOP AT mt_var INTO DATA(lv_x). lv_vars = |{ lv_vars }{ lv_x } |. ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#VARS#{ lv_vars }| ).

    " ---- catalog authorizations (configs/*/actions.json auth[])
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.LIST_OPEN` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKG' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;EKGRP=<EKGRP>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.DELETE_ITEM` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=06` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.RELEASE` iv_obj = 'M_EINK_FRG' iv_spec = `FRGGR=<FRGGR>;FRGCO=<FRGCO>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.GR.POST` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWE' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=101` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.GR.POST` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_WWE' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;WERKS=<POWERKS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.*` iv_obj = 'C_AFKO_AWK' iv_spec = `WERKS=<PPWERKS>;AUFART=<PPAUART>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.CONFIRM` iv_obj = 'C_AFRU_AWK' iv_spec = `WERKS=<PPWERKS>;AUFART=<PPAUART>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.GOODS_ISSUE` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=261` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;VTWEG=<VTWEG>;SPART=<SPART>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_AAT' iv_spec = `AUART=<AUART>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;VTWEG=<VTWEG>;SPART=<SPART>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_AAT' iv_spec = `AUART=<AUART>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.LIST_OPEN` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.POST_GI` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.POST_GI` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=601` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.BIL.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_VBRK_FKA' iv_spec = `FKART=<FKART>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.BIL.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_VBRK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.DOC.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BLA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BRGRU=<BRGRU>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_KOA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;KOART=S` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.ITEM.*` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.ORD.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'K_ORDER' iv_spec = `AUFART=<COAUART>;CO_ACTION=0003` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.ORD.SET_STATUS` iv_obj = 'K_ORDER' iv_spec = `AUFART=<COAUART>;CO_ACTION=0011` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.CC.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.REPOST.COSTS` iv_obj = 'K_CCA' iv_spec = `CO_ACTION=2076` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.REPOST.COSTS` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.PLAN.PRIMARY` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS_PLA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).

    " ---- controls: HR object (role name says non-HR) and an unknown user
    DATA(ls_ctl) = VALUE ty_chk( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'P_ORGIN' spec = `INFTY=0008;AUTHC=R` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#P_ORGIN#user={ check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_ctl ) }#caller={ check_one( iv_user = sy-uname is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    ls_ctl = VALUE #( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' spec = `ACTVT=03` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#NOUSER#{ check_one( iv_user = 'ZZNOUSER999' is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    ls_ctl = VALUE #( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'S_USER_GRP' spec = `ACTVT=01;CLASS=SUPER` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#S_USER_GRP#user={ check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    DATA(lv_deny) = 0.
    LOOP AT mt_chk INTO DATA(ls_c).
      DATA(lv_t) = check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_c ).
      DATA(lv_m) = check_one( iv_user = sy-uname is_chk = ls_c ).
      IF lv_t <> 'OK'. lv_deny = lv_deny + 1. ENDIF.
      out( |AU#CHK#{ ls_c-act }#{ ls_c-obj }#{ subst( ls_c-spec ) }#user={ lv_t }#caller={ lv_m }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#SUM#checks={ lines( mt_chk ) }#user_not_ok={ lv_deny }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

ENDCLASS.

REPORT ysc4sap_auth_u1.

* YSC4SAP_AUTH_U1 - read only. Checks the catalog authorizations of the biz actions
* for another user (AUTHORITY_CHECK with USER) and for the caller. No data change.

CLASS ltcl_auth DEFINITION FINAL FOR TESTING DURATION SHORT RISK LEVEL HARMLESS.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CONSTANTS c_user TYPE xubname VALUE '11A01101B12'.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_chk,
             act  TYPE string,
             obj  TYPE xuobject,
             spec TYPE string,
           END OF ty_chk.
    DATA mt_chk TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_chk WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA mt_var TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS run FOR TESTING.
    METHODS out IMPORTING iv TYPE csequence.
    METHODS chk IMPORTING iv_act TYPE string iv_obj TYPE xuobject iv_spec TYPE string.
    METHODS subst IMPORTING iv TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
    METHODS check_one IMPORTING iv_user TYPE xubname is_chk TYPE ty_chk
                      RETURNING VALUE(rv) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_auth IMPLEMENTATION.

  METHOD out.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = iv quit = if_aunit_constants=>no level = if_aunit_constants=>tolerable ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD chk.
    APPEND VALUE #( act = iv_act obj = iv_obj spec = iv_spec ) TO mt_chk.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subst.
    rv = iv.
    LOOP AT mt_var INTO DATA(lv_var).
      SPLIT lv_var AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_k) DATA(lv_v).
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF lv_k IN rv WITH lv_v.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_one.
    DATA: lt_f TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xufield WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_v TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xuval WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_f TYPE xufield, lv_v TYPE xuval.
    DATA(lv_spec) = subst( is_chk-spec ).
    SPLIT lv_spec AT ';' INTO TABLE DATA(lt_pairs).
    LOOP AT lt_pairs INTO DATA(lv_pair).
      SPLIT lv_pair AT '=' INTO DATA(lv_fn) DATA(lv_fv).
      lv_f = lv_fn. lv_v = lv_fv.
      " field must belong to the object
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tobj WHERE objct = is_chk-obj
        AND ( fiel1 = lv_f OR fiel2 = lv_f OR fiel3 = lv_f OR fiel4 = lv_f OR fiel5 = lv_f
           OR fiel6 = lv_f OR fiel7 = lv_f OR fiel8 = lv_f OR fiel9 = lv_f OR fiel0 = lv_f ).
      IF sy-dbcnt = 0.
        rv = |BADFIELD { lv_f }|.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_f TO lt_f. APPEND lv_v TO lt_v.
    ENDLOOP.
    DO 10 - lines( lt_f ) TIMES.
      APPEND space TO lt_f. APPEND space TO lt_v.
    ENDDO.
    CALL FUNCTION 'AUTHORITY_CHECK'
      EXPORTING
        user    = iv_user
        object  = is_chk-obj
        field1  = lt_f[ 1 ]  value1  = lt_v[ 1 ]
        field2  = lt_f[ 2 ]  value2  = lt_v[ 2 ]
        field3  = lt_f[ 3 ]  value3  = lt_v[ 3 ]
        field4  = lt_f[ 4 ]  value4  = lt_v[ 4 ]
        field5  = lt_f[ 5 ]  value5  = lt_v[ 5 ]
        field6  = lt_f[ 6 ]  value6  = lt_v[ 6 ]
        field7  = lt_f[ 7 ]  value7  = lt_v[ 7 ]
        field8  = lt_f[ 8 ]  value8  = lt_v[ 8 ]
        field9  = lt_f[ 9 ]  value9  = lt_v[ 9 ]
        field10 = lt_f[ 10 ] value10 = lt_v[ 10 ]
      EXCEPTIONS
        user_dont_exist     = 1
        user_is_authorized  = 2
        user_not_authorized = 3
        user_is_locked      = 4
        OTHERS              = 5.
    rv = SWITCH #( sy-subrc WHEN 2 THEN 'OK' WHEN 3 THEN 'DENY' WHEN 1 THEN 'NOUSER'
                            WHEN 4 THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE |RC{ sy-subrc }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD run.
    " ---- user facts (no address, no password data)
    CALL FUNCTION 'SUSR_USER_CHECK_EXISTENCE'
      EXPORTING user_name = c_user
      EXCEPTIONS user_name_not_exists = 1 OTHERS = 2.
    out( |AU#USER#{ c_user }#exists={ COND #( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN 'X' ELSE '-' ) }#caller={ sy-uname }#client={ sy-mandt }| ).
    SELECT SINGLE ustyp, uflag, gltgv, gltgb FROM usr02 WHERE bname = @c_user INTO @DATA(ls_u).
    out( |AU#LOGON#type={ ls_u-ustyp }#lockflag={ ls_u-uflag }#valid={ ls_u-gltgv }-{ ls_u-gltgb }| ).
    SELECT agr_name FROM agr_users WHERE uname = @c_user AND from_dat <= @sy-datum AND to_dat >= @sy-datum
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_roles).
    DATA(lv_roles) = ``.
    LOOP AT lt_roles INTO DATA(ls_r). lv_roles = |{ lv_roles }{ ls_r-agr_name },|. ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#ROLES#{ lines( lt_roles ) }#{ lv_roles }| ).

    " ---- org values from the test documents
    SELECT SINGLE ekgrp, frggr, frgsx, bsart FROM ekko WHERE ebeln = '8000000007' INTO @DATA(ls_po).
    SELECT SINGLE werks FROM ekpo WHERE ebeln = '8000000007' INTO @DATA(lv_po_werks).
    SELECT SINGLE frgc1 FROM t16fs WHERE frggr = @ls_po-frggr AND frgsx = @ls_po-frgsx INTO @DATA(lv_frgco).
    SELECT SINGLE vkorg, vtweg, spart, auart FROM vbak WHERE vbeln = '3100003658' INTO @DATA(ls_so).
    SELECT SINGLE vstel, fkarv FROM likp WHERE vbeln = '8100002214' INTO @DATA(ls_dl).
    SELECT SINGLE brgru FROM t003 WHERE blart = 'SA' INTO @DATA(lv_brgru).
    SELECT SINGLE auart, kokrs FROM aufk WHERE aufnr = '000800001501' INTO @DATA(ls_co).
    SELECT SINGLE kostl FROM csks WHERE kokrs = @ls_co-kokrs AND datbi >= @sy-datum INTO @DATA(lv_kostl).
    SELECT SINGLE werks, auart FROM aufk WHERE autyp = '10' INTO @DATA(ls_pp).
    mt_var = VALUE #(
      ( |<EKGRP>={ ls_po-ekgrp }| ) ( |<FRGGR>={ ls_po-frggr }| ) ( |<FRGCO>={ lv_frgco }| ) ( |<POWERKS>={ lv_po_werks }| )
      ( |<VKORG>={ ls_so-vkorg }| ) ( |<VTWEG>={ ls_so-vtweg }| ) ( |<SPART>={ ls_so-spart }| ) ( |<AUART>={ ls_so-auart }| )
      ( |<VSTEL>={ ls_dl-vstel }| ) ( |<FKART>={ ls_dl-fkarv }| ) ( |<BUKRS>=1100| ) ( |<BRGRU>={ lv_brgru }| )
      ( |<COAUART>={ ls_co-auart }| ) ( |<KOKRS>={ ls_co-kokrs }| ) ( |<KOSTL>={ lv_kostl }| )
      ( |<PPWERKS>={ ls_pp-werks }| ) ( |<PPAUART>={ ls_pp-auart }| ) ).
    DATA(lv_vars) = ``.
    LOOP AT mt_var INTO DATA(lv_x). lv_vars = |{ lv_vars }{ lv_x } |. ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#VARS#{ lv_vars }| ).

    " ---- catalog authorizations (configs/*/actions.json auth[])
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.LIST_OPEN` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKG' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;EKGRP=<EKGRP>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.DELETE_ITEM` iv_obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' iv_spec = `ACTVT=06` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.PO.RELEASE` iv_obj = 'M_EINK_FRG' iv_spec = `FRGGR=<FRGGR>;FRGCO=<FRGCO>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.GR.POST` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWE' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=101` ).
    chk( iv_act = `MM.GR.POST` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_WWE' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;WERKS=<POWERKS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.*` iv_obj = 'C_AFKO_AWK' iv_spec = `WERKS=<PPWERKS>;AUFART=<PPAUART>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.CONFIRM` iv_obj = 'C_AFRU_AWK' iv_spec = `WERKS=<PPWERKS>;AUFART=<PPAUART>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `PP.ORD.GOODS_ISSUE` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=261` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;VTWEG=<VTWEG>;SPART=<SPART>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_AAT' iv_spec = `AUART=<AUART>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;VTWEG=<VTWEG>;SPART=<SPART>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.SO.CHANGE*` iv_obj = 'V_VBAK_AAT' iv_spec = `AUART=<AUART>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.LIST_OPEN` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=03` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.POST_GI` iv_obj = 'V_LIKP_VST' iv_spec = `VSTEL=<VSTEL>;ACTVT=02` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.DLV.POST_GI` iv_obj = 'M_MSEG_BWA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BWART=601` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.BIL.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_VBRK_FKA' iv_spec = `FKART=<FKART>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `SD.BIL.CREATE` iv_obj = 'V_VBRK_VKO' iv_spec = `VKORG=<VKORG>;ACTVT=01` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.DOC.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BLA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;BRGRU=<BRGRU>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.GL.POST` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_KOA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;KOART=S` ).
    chk( iv_act = `FI.ITEM.*` iv_obj = 'F_BKPF_BUK' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02;BUKRS=<BUKRS>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.ORD.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'K_ORDER' iv_spec = `AUFART=<COAUART>;CO_ACTION=0003` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.ORD.SET_STATUS` iv_obj = 'K_ORDER' iv_spec = `AUFART=<COAUART>;CO_ACTION=0011` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.CC.GET_DETAIL` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS' iv_spec = `ACTVT=03;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.REPOST.COSTS` iv_obj = 'K_CCA' iv_spec = `CO_ACTION=2076` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.REPOST.COSTS` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS' iv_spec = `ACTVT=02;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).
    chk( iv_act = `CO.PLAN.PRIMARY` iv_obj = 'K_CSKS_PLA' iv_spec = `ACTVT=01;KOKRS=<KOKRS>;KOSTL=<KOSTL>` ).

    " ---- controls: HR object (role name says non-HR) and an unknown user
    DATA(ls_ctl) = VALUE ty_chk( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'P_ORGIN' spec = `INFTY=0008;AUTHC=R` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#P_ORGIN#user={ check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_ctl ) }#caller={ check_one( iv_user = sy-uname is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    ls_ctl = VALUE #( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'M_BEST_EKO' spec = `ACTVT=03` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#NOUSER#{ check_one( iv_user = 'ZZNOUSER999' is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    ls_ctl = VALUE #( act = `CONTROL` obj = 'S_USER_GRP' spec = `ACTVT=01;CLASS=SUPER` ).
    out( |AU#CTL#S_USER_GRP#user={ check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_ctl ) }| ).
    DATA(lv_deny) = 0.
    LOOP AT mt_chk INTO DATA(ls_c).
      DATA(lv_t) = check_one( iv_user = c_user is_chk = ls_c ).
      DATA(lv_m) = check_one( iv_user = sy-uname is_chk = ls_c ).
      IF lv_t <> 'OK'. lv_deny = lv_deny + 1. ENDIF.
      out( |AU#CHK#{ ls_c-act }#{ ls_c-obj }#{ subst( ls_c-spec ) }#user={ lv_t }#caller={ lv_m }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
    out( |AU#SUM#checks={ lines( mt_chk ) }#user_not_ok={ lv_deny }| ).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline.
